description: Embeds papers with a model stored in this project (e.g. one the engineer fine-tuned on Kaggle), through sentence-transformers. Needs the research-hub:full image (RH_LOCAL_EMBED=on) or an embedding server at RH_LOCAL_EMBED_URL.

model.description: The model folder, relative to the project's data folder (e.g. engineer/models/3).

dims.description: Vector size (0: learned from the model).
